messages:
maria: Heads up — canary rollout for prompt-routing v2 is spiking 5xxs and tail latency in EU region. Seeing customer errors and retry storms from a few downstream services. Not good.
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Canary deployment started by jen at 2026-03-15T10:07Z — canary=10% route=prompt-v2 eu-west-1.
incidents-bot: Incident created: #INC-4829 - Canary latency/error spike (triggered by alerting rule: prompt-router-eu-5xx-rate > 1%). Paging @oncall.
alex: I'm oncall, looking. Which flag/endpoint was included in the canary?
maria: canary flipped new endpoint: /v2/prompt-router (flag: feature.prompt_router_v2). Only EU traffic so far.
sam: I'm seeing repeated KV-cache misses in the logs for v2, and a lot of 504s from the backend transformer pool. CPU on the transformer tasks is fine but queuing is bad. P95 go up to 2.8s, errors ~3.5%.
jen: Rolling back is an option. We also have a fast FF toggle in the console. Which do we want?
alex: Let's try the kill-switch for the feature flag first (less blast radius). If FR drop after toggle = good. If not, rollback canary.
jen: On it. I'm toggling feature.prompt_router_v2 -> OFF for canary slice (eu-west-1). Command I used in admin console: 
```
POST /api/internal/flags/toggle
payload: {"flag":"feature.prompt_router_v2","scope":"eu-west-1-canary","state":"off"}
```
maria: Confirm when done. Also add note to incident: potential cascading retries to upstream.
jen: done. Toggled OFF at 2026-03-15T10:10:05Z. (UI trace id: ui-8c3f).
incidents-bot: Action logged: feature.prompt_router_v2 toggled OFF by jen.
sam: Metrics: error rate dropping already — from 3.5% -> 1.2% in the last 60s. Latency p95 down to 1.1s. Good signal.
alex: Nice. Can we confirm no customer-facing degradations remain? Any queued requests or replays?
maria: Ops team reports backlog processing but no new customer-facing 5xxs from the route. Still tracking a small buffer of retries in the retry-queue for some tenants.
jen: I recommend keeping the FF OFF and abort the canary rollout. I'll gate the deployment pipeline. Command to abort pipeline: 
```
POST /api/internal/deploys/abort
payload: {"deploy_id":"canary-6734"}
```
jen: aborted canary at 2026-03-15T10:12:42Z.
alex: Good. Sam, can you validate that the transformer pool isn't overloaded and that KV caches warm back?
sam: Transformer queue length normalized within 90s of kill. KV hits creeping back up. No OOMs or thread crashes.
maria: Customer impact assessment:
- Affected: ~12 orgs in EU with heavy prompt-routing usage.
- Visible symptoms: elevated response latencies, intermittent 5xx from /v2/prompt-router.
- Duration: ~10:07Z - 10:12Z (mitigated by FF toggle).
- Severity: P2 (partial outage for subset of customers)
We should notify affected customers and open a ticket template.
alex: Agreed. Jen, can you open the customer-notification draft? I'll review. Use the template under docs/incidents/customer-notif.md.
jen: Drafted and sent to #customer-ops for review. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/INC-4829-cust-notif
alex: Handing off to Sam for postmortem follow-up and timeline. I need to jump to another pager in 10m. @sam you're OOO tomorrow morning — can you own the follow-up for postmortem and RCA?
sam: I can own it. Will pull logs, timeline, and check correlation with the recent kernel/quantization change rolled earlier this week.
maria: Quick list of TODOs: 1) Add more observability on kv-cache warm paths 2) Add throttling to retry-queue to avoid retry storms 3) Ensure canary slices have a safety throttle on request concurrency 4) Postmortem within 48h.
jen: Also adding a temporary predeploy check to block canary if backend transformer latency > 500ms baseline.
incidents-bot: Incident #INC-4829 status -> mitigated. Mitigation: feature flag kill-switch (feature.prompt_router_v2 OFF) + canary abort.
alex: Thanks team. Sam — I'll hand off the full war-room logs and timeline to you before I leave. Last check: are we confident to leave the flag OFF until the RCA?
sam: Yes, leave it OFF. We'll only re-enable after fix + controlled canary with tighter throttles.
maria: I'll schedule a quick post-incident sync at 16:00Z and invite infra, runtime, and product.
jen: Adding postmortem owners and RLs now.
alex: One last note: create a short blameless summary for execs and include cost impact estimate (extra retries, failed requests) in the postmortem doc.
maria: Will do. Closing thread from my side. :white_check_mark:
